stem: ![](asset:P000344-stem-1)Three blocks A, B and C are connected by inextensible strings, are placed on a fixed wedge of inclination 30°. The contact surfaces are frictionless and the pulleys are frictionless and massless. Then choose correct statements:

options.A: The acceleration of block A is $\frac{3g}{8}$

assets.alt: Block B (2 kg) on an incline of 30°. String 1 runs from B over a pulley at the top to a hanging block C (2 kg). String 2 runs from B down the incline, over a pulley at the bottom, to a hanging block A (4 kg).
